stem.en: A 14-year-old's body has begun to produce sperm. Which statement is correct?

text.en: He is now ready for all the responsibilities of an adult.

feedback.en: His body is maturing, but adult responsibilities need more than that.

text.en: His body is maturing, but emotional maturity takes longer.

feedback.en: Correct. Sexual maturity comes first, and emotional maturity takes longer.

text.en: All his growing, of body and of mind, has now come to an end.

feedback.en: He will keep growing and changing for years.

text.en: Bigger bodies always mean people who are ready for decisions.

feedback.en: Body size says nothing about thoughtful decisions.

explanation.en: Sexual maturity means the body is becoming capable of reproduction. Emotional maturity means handling feelings, communicating clearly and making thoughtful decisions, and it takes longer.

hints.en: Are body changes and emotional growth the same thing?
